New added covers = New Comis Published

You can read my comics here on Global Comix (NEW):
https://globalcomix.com/c/side-hustles-of-obscurities

You can download or read directly on Google Drive the comics at this folder:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1z9RZwHxbzMLISbjSRiFg3B68H-_n4ook?usp=sharing

I will be publishing mostly Yu-Gi-Oh related comics focusing on the backstories of the most interesting creatures from the Duel Monsters game from now on, so that is why the new cover arts will be about them, I am sharing the comics in a dedicated series at Global Comix, having finished the "Shiny Obscurities #1" series with number 100.

Each comic is never a repeat, always a unique one-shot story, focusing on much less known interesting characters from visual media (mostly videogames, manga, comics, animation).

When uploading new covers for newly published comics, I'll be swapping around the other ones to keep things fresh.

There is everything for anybody.
